QuestInfo.name: Biggs's Story on Victoria Island.
QuestInfo.0: Go to #bSouthperry#k and meet up with #bBiggs#k to learn more about Victoria Island, like Bari suggests.
QuestInfo.1: Biggs tells you the basics of Victoria Island and advises that you speak with Olaf once you land there. Okay, gotta remember that. #bLith Harbor#k. Meet #bOlaf#k. Okay!
QuestInfo.2: Olaf seemed genuinely happy to meet a new traveler and said if you want to learn more about job advancement, he's your man!

0.0: You must be new. You've made your way to Southperry, so I suppose you're ready to head to Victoria Island, right? Making a journey to an unknown place requires preparation. Would you like some information on #bVictoria Island#k?

yes.0: Victoria Island is a #bhumongous#k island! That place, along with the continent of Ossyria, takes up the majority of Maple World. I heard Victoria Island used to be one with Ossyria...
yes.1: Anyway, Victoria Island has #bfour major towns#k along with #bone port#k in the southwest, a harbor where #bThe Nautilus#k is docked in the southeast, and the small town of Sleepywood in the center. #bA job instructor#k can be found in #beach major town and in The Nautilus#k. These instructors are who you need to visit to make a job advancement.
yes.2: Maple Island can't possibly compare to Victoria Island in size. I hear that Orange Mushrooms, the strongest monsters on Maple Island, are nothing compared to the grisly beasts on Victoria Island!
yes.3: Beginners that set foot in Victoria Island should be very careful. But no worries. The first place you'll land at Victoria Island, #bLith Harbor#k, has someone that specializes in helping out Beginners like you.
yes.4: Look for #bOlaf#k at #bLith Harbor#k. He'll help you get acclimated to Victoria Island. He shouldn't be hard to find. Good luck on your journey!

no.0: Hmmm... If you don't need information, then oh well...

1.0: You must be new... I can smell it! Muahaha! Have you just arrived from Maple Island? If so, then I, the great Olaf, shall help you.

yes.0: This world may be full of dangerous monsters, but people oughta stick together and help each other out, am I right or am I right? Especially a youngling like you, who's the future of the Maple World.
yes.1: Ah, lessee. I can help you out with your first job advancement. I'm friends with all the chiefs on this island, so I know a ton about every occupation. I'll help you find the perfect job!

npc.0: You haven't made your way to Victoria Island yet. It's a good idea to quietly train here until you're ready to make a job advancement. Once you are, then head to Victoria Island and find #bOlaf#k at #bLith Harbor#k.
